title: PROFINET: Fix leaks
description:
No need to g_strdup a string that is only used for temporary comparisons
or for sscanf. When any of these strings are actually saved, they are
strdup'ed again.

Close a directory after we're done with it (it doesn't really make sense
to only look at the first file in some unknown order from it; comment
that.)

Also fix up the bitmask similar to 4226b8542540f617d27aa62c4fb03b

There are some more leaks left that will require more fixes, mostly
in strings in the ParserState never freed (and some things that
aren't leaked are incorrectly duplicated in file scope.)

Fixup 6d1dab030a25e021eb2b01f934c801c4665c7521

Several trailing whitespace issues were also automatically fixed by
EditorConfig.
